Allergen practice

Sesame chickpeas

Szezámos csicseriborsó

6 months+ Adjusted 20 min 2 portions

Serve on a spoon or thinned further. Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. Once sesame is tolerated, keep offering it a few times a week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 100 g cooked chickpeas (dried chickpeas boiled until completely soft; not firm beans from salted brine)
  • 1 tsp tahini (smooth sesame paste; do not add whole sesame seeds)
  • a few drops lemon juice (fresh lemon)

Allergens

sesame

Method

  1. Start with chickpeas boiled until they are completely soft, then drain them.
  2. Blend them with the tahini and a few drops of lemon.
  3. Add cooking water until the mix is loose and falls from the spoon.
  4. Serve on a spoon, or thin it further.
  5. Do not sprinkle whole sesame seeds on top.

Adjusted

Whole sesame seeds are a choking hazard and a weak dose.

Blend cooked chickpeas with a teaspoon of tahini and a few drops of lemon until loose. Tahini is the introduction, not scattered seeds.
